meaning: To take part in an activity.

meaning: Money given by the government to help a business.

meaning: Having the skill to do a job well.

meaning: Peaceful and friendly agreement among people.

meaning: Disagreement or bad feeling between people.

meaning: Having many different kinds of people together.

meaning: Equal rights and chances for everyone.

meaning: One part of a written contract or law.

meaning: Calm and in control of your feelings.

meaning: Giving a lot of time and effort to a task.
